I replied to Pree in their #central-team thread and saved the deadline to the brain under Tansley Parcel: the signed order form is due 25 August.

Their message didn't give a year. It's 14 October 2026 on the simulation clock, so this year's 25 August has already passed. I saved the fact without a year and asked Pree whether they mean 25 August 2027. Once they confirm, the year should be added to that saved fact.

I found nothing in the brain that conflicts with this deadline. The brain is running keyword-only search right now, though, so that's not a guarantee nothing else is there. The date isn't a money term, so it was fine to talk about it in the team channel.
